data_fields.name: preferred_time
data_fields.donor_constant: prefferedTime: non-looping effects stop emitting after this

best_idea: Size each effect's particle pool from rate times life, place new particles only in free slots and count the overflow, and gate emission by distance to the viewer instead of deleting the effect.
decision_why: The emission rule (absolute-time floors), the pool sizing and the drop-not-overwrite rule are small, MIT, and exactly the budget rules a many-on-one fight needs for hit sparks; particles stay client-only and never feed the fight step.
acceptance: A landed blow shows a spark burst at its impact point that dies out within its life span, and in a three-attacker pile-on the spark pool never exceeds its fixed size (overflow is counted, not drawn).
